{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-b27yce",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop at P-R (n-ax2alr) directly triggered the local controls showing supply complaints and request for attendance (n-b27yce). The point register maps AL-44 to low-pressure input from P-R, so a drop below 4.5 bar activates the alarm condition.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R pressure had remained above 5.0 bar, the alarm would not have activated and local controls would not show complaints.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; physical mapping of point register supports direct causation.",
      "evidenceGap": "Timing precision between exact drop moment and complaint generation is unknown but likely negligible."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q47r99",
      "toKey": "n-b27yce",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The daily briefing lacked valve-by-valve content (n-1q47r99), which may have prevented the crew from recognizing that a service-routing change or undocumented valve state could exist, enabling the hazard scenario when pressure dropped.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, it might have alerted crew to check for routing changes before work started.",
      "competingExplanation": "Briefing absence alone does not prove hazard; could be coincidental timing of unrecorded change with normal pressure fluctuation.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether a service-routing change occurred or if the briefing content was sufficient to prevent misunderstanding."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q7dwrs",
      "toKey": "n-b27yce",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The blank field execution record (n-q7dwrs) indicates no documented confirmation of understanding regarding response steps or root cause assessment, which may have contributed to delayed recognition of the hazard.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the field execution record had been completed with confirmation of understanding, crew might have responded more effectively.",
      "competingExplanation": "Blank form may reflect administrative delay rather than lack of communication; no evidence shows response was delayed beyond normal coordination.",
      "evidenceGap": "No direct link between blank form and actual response timing or effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1b1mn9d",
      "toKey": "n-b27yce",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Unknown whether crew saw recent changes (n-1b1mn9d) or used outdated equipment-location sheets, which could have enabled the hazard scenario if a service-routing change existed.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If crew had seen recent changes, they might have recognized the hazard earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "Crew may not need to see every change if procedures are robust; absence of evidence does not prove lack of awareness.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether crew used updated drawings or saw routing changes."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1evg1rq",
      "toKey": "n-b27yce",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Maintenance receiver M-A had boundary acceptance pending (n-1evg1rq), which may have contributed to delayed response if the change owner did not attach a temporary instruction.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If boundary acceptance had been completed with proper documentation, response might have been faster.",
      "competingExplanation": "Pending acceptance does not prove delay; could be normal workflow timing.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence links pending acceptance to actual response time or effectiveness."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The focal event (instrument-air low-pressure indication) was caused by a pressure drop at P-R, which triggered the alarm and local complaints. Contributing factors include lack of valve-by-valve briefing content, blank field execution record, unknown crew awareness of routing changes, and pending boundary acceptance. Evidence gaps remain regarding whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred or if these administrative issues directly caused delayed response.","evidenceUsed":["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],"unknowns":["Whether a service-routing change occurred between 2024-03-01 and May 20, 2024.","Whether crew saw recent changes or used outdated drawings.","Exact timing of pressure drop vs. alarm activation."],"alternatives":["Pressure drop was due to normal fluctuation rather than unrecorded routing change.","Administrative gaps did not materially affect response time.","Communication breakdown is unsupported by evidence; request/response sequence appears normal."],"confidence":0.75},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1","id\":\"eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078\",\"claimRef\":\"n-gkf844\"},{,"
  ]}
